title: 24th Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/24/2/2026).
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of a member to the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of an ambassador to the United Kingdom (Foreign Service Act, Law No. 20/2021, Article 14) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the bill to amend the Goods and Services Tax Act (Law No. 10/2011), a government bill submitted by Kulhudhuffushi North MP Mohamed Dawood.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Goods and Services Tax Act (Law No. 10/2011).

Continued debate (unfinished business) on Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed's resolution urging the government to immediately halt the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" selling permanent residency to foreigners and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
Finance Committee report on the Ministry of Higher Education's 2022 financial audit report.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The government's GST amendment bill was introduced and debated, two presidential nominations went to committee, and the Pearl Residence resolution debate continued.
